description: This file defines error code handling functions, macros, and related constants for the USP (Universal Service Platform) software component. It includes function declarations for setting, clearing, and retrieving error messages, as well as macros for error handling and assertions.

methods.name: USP_ERR_Init
methods.description: Initializes the USP error system, likely setting up internal buffers or states.

methods.name: USP_ERR_SetMessage_Sql
methods.description: Sets an error message related to a SQL function call, including context such as function name, line number, and database handle.

methods.name: USP_ERR_SetMessage_SqlParam
methods.description: Sets an error message with SQL context, similar to USP_ERR_SetMessage_Sql, possibly for parameterized SQL statements.

methods.name: USP_ERR_ToString
methods.description: Converts an error code into a human-readable string, storing it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: USP_ERR_UspErrToString
methods.description: Converts a USP error code into a string description.

methods.name: USP_ERR_SetMessage_Errno
methods.description: Sets an error message based on an errno value, associated with a specific function failure.

methods.name: USP_ERR_ClearMessage
methods.description: Clears the current error message buffer.

methods.name: USP_ERR_ReplaceEmptyMessage
methods.description: Replaces an empty error message with a formatted string, similar to printf.

methods.name: USP_ERR_GetMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the current stored error message.

methods.name: USP_ERR_Terminate
methods.description: Terminates the program execution with a formatted message when a critical error occurs.

methods.name: USP_ERR_Terminate_BadCase
methods.description: Terminates the program due to an invalid case detection, with details about the function and value.

methods.name: USP_ERR_Terminate_OnAssert
methods.description: Terminates the program when an assertion fails, recording the failed statement.
